args.sql:
SELECT
    t1.audregistry AS audio_id,
    t2.makername AS manufacturer_name,
    t2.modnum AS model_number,
    t1.thdpct AS total_harmonic_distortion,
    t1.spksensedb AS speaker_sensitivity,
    t1.audlatms AS audio_latency,
    (t1.thdpct + t1.spksensedb + t1.audlatms) AS calculated_AQI
FROM
    audioandmedia AS t1
JOIN
    deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.auddevref = t2.devregistry
WHERE
    t1.thdpct > 8.0
ORDER BY
    calculated_AQI DESC;
